title: Adding a CLI option, chasing a flaky test, and designing log rotation
source: Scripted by the assistant against this repository (auto-model); not a recorded OpenCode session. Each turn was written to sit clearly in one tier given the conversation so far.

turns.assistant: It routes a single prompt through the routing core against the live router and prints the decision and its log record.
turns.label: small

turns.user: Which test file covers the policy?
turns.label: small

turns.user: Add a --threshold option to route-once that overrides the configured fallback threshold, and update its usage message.
turns.assistant: Added the option, passed it into the policy, and updated the usage text.
turns.label: medium

turns.user: Write a unit test for the new option.
turns.assistant: Added a test that a confidence of 0.5 falls back at --threshold 0.6 and is kept at 0.4.
turns.label: medium

turns.assistant: 77 pass and 1 fails: the new test expects the default tier at 0.6 but gets the proposed one.
turns.label: small

turns.assistant: The option arrived as a string, so the comparison was wrong. It is now parsed as a number and checked to lie between 0 and 1. All tests pass.
turns.label: medium

turns.assistant: Renamed it in the parser, usage text and test.
turns.label: small

turns.user: Commit that with a sensible message.
turns.label: small

turns.user: Separately, the evaluate test fails about one run in twenty on CI but never locally. Find out why.
turns.assistant: CI runs test files in parallel. A likely cause is interleaved appends to the decision log, but nothing conclusive yet.
turns.label: large

turns.user: Try making the log writes sequential.
turns.assistant: Wrapped appendDecision in a per-file queue. Ran the suite 40 times: still two failures.
turns.label: medium

turns.user: It's still failing at the same rate, so that wasn't it. Step back and reason about what else differs between CI and local runs.
turns.assistant: Several test files fall back to the default log path in the home directory. On CI they run at once and read each other's records; locally they run one at a time.
turns.label: large

turns.user: Make each test write its log to its own temporary directory.
turns.assistant: Each test now creates a temporary directory with mkdtemp and removes it afterwards.
turns.label: medium

turns.user: Run the tests twenty times in a row and tell me whether any fail.
turns.label: small

turns.user: Add a line about this to the known issues section of the README.
turns.assistant: Added one sentence noting that tests must not share the default log path.
turns.label: small

turns.user: Now design how the decision log should rotate once it passes 100 MB, without losing or splitting records when two OpenCode processes write to it at the same time.
turns.assistant: Proposed rename-based rotation guarded by an exclusive lock file, with writers reopening the file when its inode changes, and set out the failure cases.
turns.label: large

turns.user: Implement the rotation as designed, with tests.
turns.assistant: Implemented the lock, rename and reopen steps, and added tests for rotation and for two concurrent writers.
turns.label: medium

turns.user: How many lines is src/core/log.ts now?
turns.label: small
